app.name: FitSense
app.tagline: Pakistani fashion ke liye Universal Fit Intelligence

hero.title: Apna size andaze se mat lagayein
hero.subtitle: Aik profile. Khaadi, Sapphire, Breakout, Diners aur Outfitters par bilkul sahi size recommendation.

problem.title: Size ka masla
problem.description: Khaadi ka Medium Sapphire ke Medium se mukhtalif hai. Har brand ki pemaish alag hoti hai, is liye aap kai size mangwate hain ya khareedte hi nahi.

howItWorks.title: Yeh kaise kaam karta hai
howItWorks.step1: Apni body profile aik martaba banayein
howItWorks.step2: Koi bhi store aur product select karein
howItWorks.step3: Confidence score ke sath apna sahi size hasil karein
howItWorks.description: Hum aapki asal pemaish ka brand ke real size chart se mawazna karte hain.

retailers.title: Retailers ke liye
retailers.description: Size ki wapsi kam karein aur buyers ka bharosa barhayein.

auth.loginSubtitle: Apni universal sizing profile tak rasai hasil karein
auth.signupSubtitle: Tamam Pakistani fashion brands ke liye aik profile
auth.noAccount: Account nahi hai? Sign up karein
auth.hasAccount: Pehle se account hai? Log in karein
auth.loginSuccess: Kamiyabi se log in ho gaya!
auth.signupSuccess: Account ban gaya! Aayein profile mukammal karein.

onboarding.title: Profile Setup
onboarding.step1Subtitle: Size aur pemaish dekhne ke liye apni pasand select karein
onboarding.step2Title: Aap ka Data, Aap ka Control
onboarding.step2Subtitle: Hum aapki body measurements ko bilkul private aur mehfooz rakhte hain.
onboarding.consentBullet1: Hum measurements sirf product recommendation calculate karne ke liye store karte hain.
onboarding.consentBullet2: Aap ka data kabhi kisi ko becha ya share nahi kiya jata.
onboarding.consentBullet3: Aap kisi bhi waqt apna data download ya hamesha ke liye delete kar sakte hain.
onboarding.consentCheckbox: Main FitSense ko apni body measurements aur fit preferences store karne ki ijazat deta/deti hoon.
onboarding.step3Subtitle: Apna naap darj karein ya apne kisi pasandeeda kapray ko naapein.
onboarding.orGarment: Ya apne kisi kapray ka naap darj karein
onboarding.garmentModalDesc: Kisi achi fitting wale shirt ya kurte ko table par flat bichayein aur chest ki chaurai naapein.
onboarding.calculateEstimateBtn: Andaza-shuda body measurement ke tor par lagayein
onboarding.estimateBadge: Kapray se andaza lagaya gaya. Aap niche kisi bhi value ko tabdeel kar sakte hain.
onboarding.step4Subtitle: Aap har category mein kesi fitting pasand karte hain?

tips.chest: Seene ke sab se broad hissay ke gird horizontal naapein.
tips.waist: Apni natural kamar ke gird naapein.
tips.hip: Hip ke sab se chaure hissay ke gird naapein.
tips.shoulder: Aik kandhe ke kinaray se doosre kinaray tak peeth se naapein.
tips.sleeve: Kandhe ki haddi se kalai tak naapein.
tips.inseam: Taang ke andar se ooper se takhnay tak naapein.
tips.kameez_length: Kandhe ke jor se niche jahan tak daaman chahiye naapein.

profile.title: Meri Profile
profile.subtitle: Apni universal body profile aur sizing preferences manage karein
profile.completenessHelp: Chest, waist aur hip shamil karne se recommendation ka bharosa barh jata hai.
profile.savedSuccess: Profile kamiyabi se update ho gayi!
profile.storeMeasurementsDesc: Online fashion brands pe foran size recommendations ke liye measurements profile mein mehfooz rakhein.
profile.dataRightsDesc: Apne data ki copy download karein ya kisi bhi waqt apna account mukammal tor par delete karein.
profile.deleteModalDesc: Yeh action wapis nahi ho sakta. Aap ki saari measurements aur saved sizes database se mukammal khatam ho jayein gi.
profile.keepAnonymousFeedbackCheckbox: Doosray shoppers ke liye anonymous feedback barqarar rakhein (naam aur measurements foran mita di jayein gi)
profile.withdrawConsentConfirm: Consent wapis lenay se aap ki measurements delete ho jayein gi. Kya aap jari rakhna chahte hain?
profile.consentWithdrawnSuccess: Measurement storage consent wapis le li gayi. Measurements delete ho gayi hain.
profile.consentGrantedSuccess: Measurement storage enable ho gayi hai.
profile.exportSuccess: Data export kamiyabi se download ho gaya.
profile.accountDeletedSuccess: Aap ka account aur tamam data delete ho gaya hai.

try.title: Universal Size Finder
try.subtitle: Apna behtareen size janne ke liye koi bhi store aur product select karein.
try.guestNotice: Guest shopper hain? Foran recommendation ke liye chest measurement darj karein, ya profile use karne ke liye log in karein.
try.savedSizeSuccess: Size wishlist mein save ho gaya!

saved.title: Saved Products & Sizes
saved.subtitle: Woh kapray jo aap khareedne ka irada rakhte hain

saved.buyPrompt: Kya aap ne yeh item khareed liya hai?

feedback.success: Shukriya! Aap ke feedback se FitSense mazeed behtar hota hai.

privacy.title: Privacy aur Data Protection
privacy.subtitle: Aap ki body ka data sirf aap ki milkiyat hai.
privacy.legalNotice: Note: Yeh privacy policy draft legal review ke marhale mein hai.

sections.whatWeCollectBody: Hum sirf wahi measurements aur preferences lete hain jo aap khud provide karte hain.
sections.howWeUseBody: Aap ka naap sirf sahi size calculate karne ke liye use hota hai. Hum data kabhi kisi ko nahi bechte.
sections.rightsBody: Aap ko kisi bhi waqt apna data download karne aur account hamesha ke liye delete karne ka mukammal haq hai.

confirmModal.title: Kya aap waqai account delete karna chahte hain?
confirmModal.text: Yeh amal wapis nahi ho sakta. Tamam body measurements, saved sizes aur recommendations foran mita di jayein gi.
